text: A woman with red hair, likely late teens to early twenties, sits on a glowing circular floor pattern. She has fair skin, an hourglass build, and orange eyes. Her costume is a white draped garment revealing her torso and thighs; she wears a blue choker and bracelets. One hand lifts the fabric, the other rests on the ground. She appears poised for ritual or magic, gazing upward with intensity. Background suggests gothic architecture with arched windows and dim lighting.
